response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), grand AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS grand_total FROM trans) SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, a.total_amount, a.trans_count, CAST(a.total_amount AS REAL) / g.grand_total AS fraction FROM acct a JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ac.district_id CROSS JOIN grand g ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
